completeKanbanFirst: Complete Kanban setup and configure your agent profiles first
coordinatedTasksHint: The latest 100 tasks owned by this orchestrator. Open a task to manage its agent, workflow and execution.
deleteOrchestratorHint: Remove this coordinator and stop its sessions. Delivery tasks remain on the board.
name: 名称
noCoordinatedTasks: No tasks yet. Open the conversation to delegate work or ask the orchestrator to adopt an existing task.
noOrchestrators: No orchestrators yet. Add one to coordinate this workspace.
orchestrationEnable: Enable the experimental feature in System settings.
orchestratorProfileHint: This profile runs the coordinator. Delivery tasks use their own profiles, which you can change independently.
orchestratorsHint: 将全局角色添加到此工作区，选择运行它的代理并提供工作区上下文。每个分配都有独立的对话和任务。
personaExecutorProfileHint: Pin this persona to a configured local or SSH profile. Worker profiles choose where their account and tools run.
rolesHint: 每个角色只需配置一次名称、图标和指令。工作区选择代理配置、执行环境和本地上下文。保存的角色更改将在下一轮应用于所有分配。
roleAssignmentHint: 名称、图标和指令来自全局角色。角色更改将在下一轮应用于使用该角色的所有工作区。
